description: Monchug wears a long muted teal crossed-front noble coat or deel over a cream linen underlayer, with broad gold scrolling and geometric woven borders around the overlapping neckline, front edges, cuffs and hem. Refined gold motifs are scattered across the teal fabric. Dark patterned under-sleeves extend to the wrists. A broad dark brown decorated belt with large round metal ornaments secures the waist, with a tasselled hanging detail. Cream cloth is visible down the center-front opening, and dark brown patterned trousers and embroidered leather boots show beneath the long coat. His short black hair is uncovered. There is no armor, weapon, crown or fur hat.
